message.content:
**Katherine McCoy** is an American graphic designer, design critic, and educator best known for co-leading the graduate design program at Cranbrook Academy of Art with her husband, Michael McCoy.[1][2][3]

She was born in **1945** in **Decatur, Illinois**, studied industrial design at Michigan State University, and later worked at Unimark International before joining Cranbrook in **1971**.[2][3][4] Her work and teaching have been influential in design education, and she co-founded **McCoy & McCoy** and the **High Ground** design conversation series.[1][2][3]
